blurb:
This 4 hour private tour of Vancouver shows the city's most popular attractions.

Will explore historic Gastown, walk on Water Street to see the famous Steam clock. Our next attraction Stanley Park, one of the most visited attractions in British Columbia. 

Stop and explore Granville Island. Here, you'll have time to wander through the art studios, craft galleries, and the Public Market.
Our next stop will be at Queen Elizabeth Park for a stunning panoramic view of Vancouver skyline and North shore mountains
